title: Restore dense retrieval and re-measure grounding

scope.purpose: Make product-lane dense retrieval observable, obtain the owner's dependency decision, and measure retrieval-only grounding ceilings after the chosen local path is implemented.

boundaries.frozen_research_artifacts: Gate 07 and Gate 08 evidence remains read-only; no embedding or reranker artifact is recomputed, overwritten, or reinterpreted.

reference.name: product_sparse_top_k_5
reference.source: Gate 13-D frozen retrieval-only measurement; control must be reproduced in this gate.

sparse_top_k_10.decision_rule: justify top_k=10 only if the observed question-hit ceiling is at least 77/116

dense_top_k_5.decision_rule: justify dense retrieval at the current top_k only if the observed question-hit ceiling is at least 77/116

dense_top_k_10.lever: dense backend restoration at the selected top_k
dense_top_k_10.decision_rule: justify dense retrieval at top_k=10 only if it gains at least 3 percentage points over the measured sparse top_k=10 control

dense_real_reranker_top_k_10.lever: real BGE reranker only, after dense retrieval
dense_real_reranker_top_k_10.decision_rule: justify the real reranker only if it gains at least 3 percentage points over dense top_k=10; a fallback reranker does not count

pre_registered_thresholds.registration_rationale: These floors were fixed before any Gate 14-R measurement: +5 points requires at least six additional answerable question hits over the 71/116 product control; +3 points requires at least four additional hits over the relevant same-depth control.

evaluation.primary_surface: product ContextBuilder selection, retrieval-only, no answer generation
secondary_diagnostics: raw direct retriever candidate-pool recall at top-50
curriculum_structure slice for every primary configuration
backend and degradation state for every retriever/reranker

metrics.macro_recall_at_k: mean over the 116 answerable rows of relevant IDs retrieved within k divided by relevant IDs for that row
metrics.macro_precision_at_k: mean over the 116 answerable rows of relevant IDs retrieved within k divided by k
metrics.mrr: mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant result over the 116 answerable rows
metrics.question_hit_count: number of answerable rows with at least one relevant chunk in the selected context
metrics.answerable_ceiling: question_hit_count/116; report exact numerator and denominator
metrics.wilson: 95% Wilson interval for binary question-hit and micro hit proportions; report the estimator and raw numerator/denominator
metrics.latency: wall-clock elapsed time per full configuration and mean/p50/p95 per question, excluding provider calls

evaluation.category_slice: Report curriculum_structure separately with n=15, raw question hits, recall, precision, MRR, and Wilson interval for each configuration.
evaluation.control_reproduction: The sparse product top_k=5 row must reproduce Gate 13-D's 71/116 answerable ceiling before lever conclusions are made.
evaluation.zero_generation_guard: The measurement runner must use only local store/retriever/reranker objects; no provider client or completion path may be invoked.

owner_decision_required_before: installing torch, sentence-transformers, transformers, or FlagEmbedding
measuring a dense backend that requires the ML runtime
options: precomputed embeddings with light query encoder
decision_gate.current_production_statement: Because requirements.txt has no ML runtime and Dockerfile installs only that file, the deployed product is sparse-only.

owner_decision.rationale: Use the same embedding model offline to export an ONNX query encoder and persist corpus vectors; ship only ONNX Runtime, tokenizers, numpy, the query encoder, and the vector artifact. Torch is local export tooling only and must not enter requirements.txt or the Dockerfile.
owner_decision.plain_option_b_rejected: Precomputed corpus embeddings alone are insufficient: runtime queries still need the same encoder and vector space. Plain option (b) would therefore still ship torch plus the model and would save almost nothing in image size or cold start, which is the reason it was rejected.
owner_decision.unchanged_thresholds: The R0 +5 percentage-point and +3 percentage-point answerable-ceiling thresholds remain binding and are not re-registered.
owner_decision.deployment_boundary: No GCP call, deployment, Cloud Run revision, or provider generation call is authorized in this gate.

model_selection_registration.selection_rule: Compare exactly these three product-lane models on the frozen 116-question set; choose the winner by the registered retrieval metrics and runtime evidence, not by external leaderboard claims.
model_selection_registration.research_lane_boundary: BGE-M3 is excluded because Gate 07 measured BGE-M3 embeddings and its artifacts are frozen; these are new product-lane exports only.

models.justification: Existing dense_retriever.py incumbent; its official card documents 50 languages, semantic search, 384 dimensions, and mean pooling.
Its official card includes Vietnamese in the supported language list and documents query/passage prefixes; the E5 paper reports strong zero-shot retrieval performance across BEIR/MTEB.
Its official card documents 50 languages, 768-dimensional semantic-search embeddings, and mean pooling, providing a larger multilingual comparison point.
